-- page fact for page 'Rollup' (scaffold-page-fact.py). Edit freely; keep each @slicers hook comment inside its WHERE clause.
-- grain: Product[Category]
-- SUM_AMOUNT = SUM(Sales.Amount) on Sales [USERELATIONSHIP]
-- SUM_QTY = SUM(Sales.Qty) on Sales [USERELATIONSHIP]
-- TODO Orders: DAX function DISTINCTCOUNT is not decomposed into additive components
--     DISTINCTCOUNT(Sales[Sale Id])
WITH
pfs_sales AS (
  SELECT SALE_ID, DATE_KEY, STORE_KEY, PRODUCT_KEY, QTY, AMOUNT, COST FROM SALES
),
pfs_product AS (
  SELECT PRODUCT_KEY, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_KEY FROM PRODUCT
),
pfs_rollup AS (
  SELECT CHILD_PRODUCT_KEY, PARENT_PRODUCT_KEY FROM ROLLUP_MAP
),
pfs_supplier AS (
  SELECT SUPPLIER_KEY, SUPPLIER_NAME FROM SUPPLIER
),
agg_sales_ur1 AS (
  SELECT
    j2."CATEGORY" AS "G_CATEGORY",
    SUM(f."AMOUNT") AS "SUM_AMOUNT",
    SUM(f."QTY") AS "SUM_QTY"
  FROM pfs_sales f
  LEFT JOIN pfs_rollup j1 ON j1."CHILD_PRODUCT_KEY" = f."PRODUCT_KEY"
  LEFT JOIN pfs_product j2 ON j2."PRODUCT_KEY" = j1."PARENT_PRODUCT_KEY"
  WHERE 1 = 1
    /*@slicers fact="Sales" alias="f" userelationship="'Rollup'[Child Product Key]|'Sales'[Product Key]" sources="Product=pfs_product;Rollup=pfs_rollup;Supplier=pfs_supplier"*/
    AND ({{#formula ArrayLength([SupplierNameFilter2])}}) > 0
    AND (CASE WHEN {{#formula ArrayLength([SupplierNameFilter2])}} = 0 THEN TRUE ELSE (f."PRODUCT_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."CHILD_PRODUCT_KEY" FROM pfs_rollup sj1 WHERE (sj1."PARENT_PRODUCT_KEY" IN (SELECT sj2."PRODUCT_KEY" FROM pfs_product sj2 WHERE (sj2."SUPPLIER_KEY" IN (SELECT sj3."SUPPLIER_KEY" FROM pfs_supplier sj3 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj3."SUPPLIER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN {{SupplierNameFilter2}}) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{SupplierNameFilter2}} AND (sj2."SUPPLIER_KEY" IS NULL OR sj2."SUPPLIER_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."SUPPLIER_KEY" FROM pfs_supplier sjb WHERE sjb."SUPPLIER_KEY" IS NOT NULL))))) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{SupplierNameFilter2}} AND (sj1."PARENT_PRODUCT_KEY" IS NULL OR sj1."PARENT_PRODUCT_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."PRODUCT_KEY" FROM pfs_product sjb WHERE sjb."PRODUCT_KEY" IS NOT NULL))))) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{SupplierNameFilter2}} AND (f."PRODUCT_KEY" IS NULL OR f."PRODUCT_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."CHILD_PRODUCT_KEY" FROM pfs_rollup sjb WHERE sjb."CHILD_PRODUCT_KEY" IS NOT NULL)))) END)
  GROUP BY j2."CATEGORY"
)
SELECT
  "G_CATEGORY",
  "SUM_AMOUNT",
  "SUM_QTY",
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "TODO_ORDERS"
FROM agg_sales_ur1

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(d."SUPPLIER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') AS V FROM (
SELECT SUPPLIER_KEY, SUPPLIER_NAME FROM SUPPLIER
) d
UNION
SELECT '(Blank)' AS V

-- page fact for page 'Sales Overview' (scaffold-page-fact.py). Edit freely; keep each @slicers hook comment inside its WHERE clause.
-- grain: Store[Region], Calendar[Month]
-- SUM_AMOUNT = SUM(Sales.Amount) on Sales
-- SUM_COST = SUM(Sales.Cost) on Sales
-- SUM_QTY = SUM(Sales.Qty) on Sales
-- TODO West Sales: CALCULATE replaces the filter on Store[Region], a grouping column of this page: the page fact applies that filter to every component, so this measure needs its own handling (add KEEPFILTERS in the source if an intersection is meant, or model it by hand)
--     CALCULATE([Sales Amount], Store[Region] = "West")
WITH
pfs_sales AS (
  SELECT SALE_ID, DATE_KEY, STORE_KEY, PRODUCT_KEY, QTY, AMOUNT, COST FROM SALES
),
pfs_calendar AS (
  SELECT DATE_KEY, CAL_DATE, CAL_YEAR, CAL_MONTH FROM CAL
),
pfs_manager AS (
  SELECT MANAGER_KEY, MANAGER_NAME FROM MGR
),
pfs_product AS (
  SELECT PRODUCT_KEY, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_KEY FROM PRODUCT
),
pfs_store AS (
  SELECT STORE_KEY, STORE_NAME, REGION, MANAGER_KEY FROM STORE
),
pfs_supplier AS (
  SELECT SUPPLIER_KEY, SUPPLIER_NAME FROM SUPPLIER
),
agg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    j2."REGION" AS "G_REGION",
    j1."CAL_MONTH" AS "G_MONTH",
    SUM(f."AMOUNT") AS "SUM_AMOUNT",
    SUM(f."COST") AS "SUM_COST",
    SUM(f."QTY") AS "SUM_QTY"
  FROM pfs_sales f
  LEFT JOIN pfs_calendar j1 ON j1."DATE_KEY" = f."DATE_KEY"
  LEFT JOIN pfs_store j2 ON j2."STORE_KEY" = f."STORE_KEY"
  WHERE 1 = 1
    /*@slicers fact="Sales" alias="f" sources="Calendar=pfs_calendar;Manager=pfs_manager;Product=pfs_product;Store=pfs_store;Supplier=pfs_supplier"*/
    AND ({{#formula ArrayLength([YearFilter])}} + {{#formula ArrayLength([ManagerNameFilter])}} + {{#formula ArrayLength([SupplierNameFilter])}}) > 0
    AND (CASE WHEN {{#formula ArrayLength([YearFilter])}} = 0 THEN TRUE ELSE f."DATE_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."DATE_KEY" FROM pfs_calendar sj1 WHERE sj1."CAL_YEAR" IN {{YearFilter}}) END)
    AND (CASE WHEN {{#formula ArrayLength([ManagerNameFilter])}} = 0 THEN TRUE ELSE (f."STORE_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."STORE_KEY" FROM pfs_store sj1 WHERE (sj1."MANAGER_KEY" IN (SELECT sj2."MANAGER_KEY" FROM pfs_manager sj2 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj2."MANAGER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN {{ManagerNameFilter}}) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{ManagerNameFilter}} AND (sj1."MANAGER_KEY" IS NULL OR sj1."MANAGER_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."MANAGER_KEY" FROM pfs_manager sjb WHERE sjb."MANAGER_KEY" IS NOT NULL))))) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{ManagerNameFilter}} AND (f."STORE_KEY" IS NULL OR f."STORE_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."STORE_KEY" FROM pfs_store sjb WHERE sjb."STORE_KEY" IS NOT NULL)))) END)
    AND (CASE WHEN {{#formula ArrayLength([SupplierNameFilter])}} = 0 THEN TRUE ELSE (f."PRODUCT_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."PRODUCT_KEY" FROM pfs_product sj1 WHERE (sj1."SUPPLIER_KEY" IN (SELECT sj2."SUPPLIER_KEY" FROM pfs_supplier sj2 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj2."SUPPLIER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN {{SupplierNameFilter}}) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{SupplierNameFilter}} AND (sj1."SUPPLIER_KEY" IS NULL OR sj1."SUPPLIER_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."SUPPLIER_KEY" FROM pfs_supplier sjb WHERE sjb."SUPPLIER_KEY" IS NOT NULL))))) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{SupplierNameFilter}} AND (f."PRODUCT_KEY" IS NULL OR f."PRODUCT_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."PRODUCT_KEY" FROM pfs_product sjb WHERE sjb."PRODUCT_KEY" IS NOT NULL)))) END)
  GROUP BY j2."REGION", j1."CAL_MONTH"
)
SELECT
  "G_REGION",
  "G_MONTH",
  "SUM_AMOUNT",
  "SUM_COST",
  "SUM_QTY",
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "TODO_WEST_SALES"
FROM agg_sales

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(d."MANAGER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') AS V FROM (
SELECT MANAGER_KEY, MANAGER_NAME FROM MGR
) d
UNION
SELECT '(Blank)' AS V

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(d."SUPPLIER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') AS V FROM (
SELECT SUPPLIER_KEY, SUPPLIER_NAME FROM SUPPLIER
) d
UNION
SELECT '(Blank)' AS V

-- page fact for page 'Stock Cover' (scaffold-page-fact.py). Edit freely; keep each @slicers hook comment inside its WHERE clause.
-- grain: Product[Category], Store[Store Name]
-- SUM_ON_HAND = SUM(Stock.On Hand) on Stock
-- SUM_QTY = SUM(Sales.Qty) on Sales
-- SUM_ON_HAND_2 = SUM(Stock.On Hand) WHERE Store.Manager Key IS NULL on Stock
WITH
pfs_sales AS (
  SELECT SALE_ID, DATE_KEY, STORE_KEY, PRODUCT_KEY, QTY, AMOUNT, COST FROM SALES
),
pfs_stock AS (
  SELECT SNAPSHOT_DATE_KEY, STORE_KEY, PRODUCT_KEY, ON_HAND FROM STOCK
),
pfs_manager AS (
  SELECT MANAGER_KEY, MANAGER_NAME FROM MGR
),
pfs_product AS (
  SELECT PRODUCT_KEY, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_KEY FROM PRODUCT
),
pfs_store AS (
  SELECT STORE_KEY, STORE_NAME, REGION, MANAGER_KEY FROM STORE
),
pfs_supplier AS (
  SELECT SUPPLIER_KEY, SUPPLIER_NAME FROM SUPPLIER
),
agg_stock AS (
  SELECT
    j1."CATEGORY" AS "G_CATEGORY",
    j2."STORE_NAME" AS "G_STORE_NAME",
    SUM(f."ON_HAND") AS "SUM_ON_HAND",
    SUM(CASE WHEN j2."MANAGER_KEY" IS NULL THEN f."ON_HAND" END) AS "SUM_ON_HAND_2"
  FROM pfs_stock f
  LEFT JOIN pfs_product j1 ON j1."PRODUCT_KEY" = f."PRODUCT_KEY"
  LEFT JOIN pfs_store j2 ON j2."STORE_KEY" = f."STORE_KEY"
  WHERE 1 = 1
    AND f."PRODUCT_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."PRODUCT_KEY" FROM pfs_product sj1 WHERE sj1."SUPPLIER_KEY" IN (SELECT sj2."SUPPLIER_KEY" FROM pfs_supplier sj2 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj2."SUPPLIER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN ('Acme', 'Globex')))
    /*@slicers fact="Stock" alias="f" sources="Manager=pfs_manager;Product=pfs_product;Sales=pfs_sales;Store=pfs_store;Supplier=pfs_supplier"*/
    AND ({{#formula ArrayLength([RegionFilter])}} + {{#formula ArrayLength([ManagerNameFilter2])}}) > 0
    AND (CASE WHEN {{#formula ArrayLength([RegionFilter])}} = 0 THEN TRUE ELSE (f."STORE_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."STORE_KEY" FROM pfs_store sj1 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj1."REGION" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN {{RegionFilter}}) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{RegionFilter}} AND (f."STORE_KEY" IS NULL OR f."STORE_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."STORE_KEY" FROM pfs_store sjb WHERE sjb."STORE_KEY" IS NOT NULL)))) END)
    AND (CASE WHEN {{#formula ArrayLength([ManagerNameFilter2])}} = 0 THEN TRUE ELSE (f."STORE_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."STORE_KEY" FROM pfs_store sj1 WHERE (sj1."MANAGER_KEY" IN (SELECT sj2."MANAGER_KEY" FROM pfs_manager sj2 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj2."MANAGER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN {{ManagerNameFilter2}}) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{ManagerNameFilter2}} AND (sj1."MANAGER_KEY" IS NULL OR sj1."MANAGER_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."MANAGER_KEY" FROM pfs_manager sjb WHERE sjb."MANAGER_KEY" IS NOT NULL))))) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{ManagerNameFilter2}} AND (f."STORE_KEY" IS NULL OR f."STORE_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."STORE_KEY" FROM pfs_store sjb WHERE sjb."STORE_KEY" IS NOT NULL)))) END)
  GROUP BY j1."CATEGORY", j2."STORE_NAME"
),
agg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    j1."CATEGORY" AS "G_CATEGORY",
    j2."STORE_NAME" AS "G_STORE_NAME",
    SUM(f."QTY") AS "SUM_QTY"
  FROM pfs_sales f
  LEFT JOIN pfs_product j1 ON j1."PRODUCT_KEY" = f."PRODUCT_KEY"
  LEFT JOIN pfs_store j2 ON j2."STORE_KEY" = f."STORE_KEY"
  WHERE 1 = 1
    AND f."PRODUCT_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."PRODUCT_KEY" FROM pfs_product sj1 WHERE sj1."SUPPLIER_KEY" IN (SELECT sj2."SUPPLIER_KEY" FROM pfs_supplier sj2 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj2."SUPPLIER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN ('Acme', 'Globex')))
    /*@slicers fact="Sales" alias="f" sources="Manager=pfs_manager;Product=pfs_product;Stock=pfs_stock;Store=pfs_store;Supplier=pfs_supplier"*/
    AND ({{#formula ArrayLength([RegionFilter])}} + {{#formula ArrayLength([ManagerNameFilter2])}}) > 0
    AND (CASE WHEN {{#formula ArrayLength([RegionFilter])}} = 0 THEN TRUE ELSE (f."STORE_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."STORE_KEY" FROM pfs_store sj1 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj1."REGION" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN {{RegionFilter}}) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{RegionFilter}} AND (f."STORE_KEY" IS NULL OR f."STORE_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."STORE_KEY" FROM pfs_store sjb WHERE sjb."STORE_KEY" IS NOT NULL)))) END)
    AND (CASE WHEN {{#formula ArrayLength([ManagerNameFilter2])}} = 0 THEN TRUE ELSE (f."STORE_KEY" IN (SELECT sj1."STORE_KEY" FROM pfs_store sj1 WHERE (sj1."MANAGER_KEY" IN (SELECT sj2."MANAGER_KEY" FROM pfs_manager sj2 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(sj2."MANAGER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') IN {{ManagerNameFilter2}}) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{ManagerNameFilter2}} AND (sj1."MANAGER_KEY" IS NULL OR sj1."MANAGER_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."MANAGER_KEY" FROM pfs_manager sjb WHERE sjb."MANAGER_KEY" IS NOT NULL))))) OR ('(Blank)' IN {{ManagerNameFilter2}} AND (f."STORE_KEY" IS NULL OR f."STORE_KEY" NOT IN (SELECT sjb."STORE_KEY" FROM pfs_store sjb WHERE sjb."STORE_KEY" IS NOT NULL)))) END)
  GROUP BY j1."CATEGORY", j2."STORE_NAME"
)
SELECT
  "G_CATEGORY",
  "G_STORE_NAME",
  SUM("SUM_ON_HAND") AS "SUM_ON_HAND",
  SUM("SUM_QTY") AS "SUM_QTY",
  SUM("SUM_ON_HAND_2") AS "SUM_ON_HAND_2"
FROM (
  SELECT "G_CATEGORY", "G_STORE_NAME", "SUM_ON_HAND", NULL AS "SUM_QTY", "SUM_ON_HAND_2" FROM agg_stock
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "G_CATEGORY", "G_STORE_NAME", NULL AS "SUM_ON_HAND", "SUM_QTY", NULL AS "SUM_ON_HAND_2" FROM agg_sales
) u
GROUP BY "G_CATEGORY", "G_STORE_NAME"

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(d."REGION" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') AS V FROM (
SELECT STORE_KEY, STORE_NAME, REGION, MANAGER_KEY FROM STORE
) d
UNION
SELECT '(Blank)' AS V

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(CAST(d."MANAGER_NAME" AS VARCHAR), '(Blank)') AS V FROM (
SELECT MANAGER_KEY, MANAGER_NAME FROM MGR
) d
UNION
SELECT '(Blank)' AS V
